title: The sites in Azure at a glance

cards.title: The framework's two sites in Azure
cards.text: louis-agent.dev and framework.louis-agent.dev, two Container Apps in one environment.

cards.title: What runs where
cards.text: Two apps that sleep until someone visits, sharing an identity and a share.

cards.title: A release
cards.text: A merge signs in without a password and releases louis-agent.dev, then the framework's site.

cards.title: A secret's path
cards.text: From a git-ignored file into the vault; the release writes only references.

cards.title: A chat
cards.text: DNS points at the app, it wakes, and the visitor talks to its Orbi through the open door.

cards.title: The network
cards.text: Only the two apps have a public address, on 443, with a managed certificate each.
